core_obligations: Gorenstein (proof lines 4769-4780): the lci property from lemma-nodal-lci plus the lci-Gorenstein lemma gives Gorensteinness; the author also sketches the alternative route through base change, completion, and the by-hand Gorenstein verification of k[[t]] and k[[x, y]]/(xy).

Geometric reducedness (proof lines 4782-4788): it suffices that X_{overline{k}} be reduced; over the algebraically closed field the completed local rings are k[[t]] or k[[x, y]]/(xy), both reduced, which finishes the proof.
proof_roadmap: Derive Gorensteinness from the lci property (or the completion route).
Reduce geometric reducedness to reducedness over the algebraic closure.
Check reducedness on the completed local normal forms.
